1048typedef struct QDMI_PROGRAM_FORMAT_T {
1049 uint32_t version;
1050 uint32_t encoding;
1051 char id[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1052 char profile[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1053} QDMI_Program_Format;
1054
1055#ifdef __cplusplus
1056static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U);
1057static_assert(alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U);
1058static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U);
1059static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U);
1060static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U);
1061static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U);
1062#else
1063_Static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U,
1064 "QDMI_Program_Format must be 136 bytes");
1065_Static_assert(_Alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U,
1066 "QDMI_Program_Format must have four-byte alignment");
1067_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U,
1068 "QDMI_Program_Format.version must start at byte 0");
1069_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U,
1070 "QDMI_Program_Format.encoding must start at byte 4");
1071_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U,
1072 "QDMI_Program_Format.id must start at byte 8");
1073_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U,
1074 "QDMI_Program_Format.profile must start at byte 72");
1075#endif
1076
1083static inline int
1084QDMI_program_format_equal(const QDMI_Program_Format *const lhs,
1085 const QDMI_Program_Format *const rhs) {
1086 if (lhs == NULL || rhs == NULL || lhs->version != rhs->version ||
1087 lhs->encoding != rhs->encoding) {
1088 return 0;
1089 }
1090 for (size_t index = 0U; index < QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE; ++index) {
1091 if (lhs->id[index] != rhs->id[index] ||
1092 lhs->profile[index] != rhs->profile[index]) {
1093 return 0;
1094 }
1095 }
1096 return 1;
1097}
